items.6w1_d_1: I played soccer, and I watched a movie last night.
items.6w1_d_2: Did you clean your room, too?
items.6w1_d_3: Yes, I cleaned it in the morning.
items.6w1_g_1: She watched a movie last night.
items.6w1_g_3: He visited his grandma last weekend.
items.6w1_copy: Yesterday was a busy day. I cleaned my room in the morning. I played soccer in the afternoon. Last night, I watched a movie with my family.
items.6w2_d_0: Tell me about a memorable day.
items.6w2_d_1: I went to the zoo. I saw a lion and ate ice cream!
items.6w2_d_3: My dad took a lot of photos. We had a great day.
items.6w2_g_0: I went to the zoo last Sunday.
items.6w2_g_1: I saw a big lion there.
items.6w2_g_2: We ate ice cream after that.
items.6w2_copy: Last summer, I went to the beach. I saw many colorful fish in the water. I made a big sandcastle. I had so much fun that day.
items.6w3_d_0: Here's a clue: I ___ breakfast right now. What form?
items.6w3_d_1: Present continuous! I am eating breakfast right now.
items.6w3_d_3: Past simple! I ate breakfast yesterday.
items.6w3_g_0: I walk to school every day.
items.6w3_g_2: I am walking to school right now.
items.6w3_g_3: I visited my aunt three days ago.
items.6w3_copy: Every day, I brush my teeth twice. Yesterday, I brushed my teeth twice, too. Right now, I am brushing my teeth. A detective looks at time words before deciding the verb.
items.6w4_d_0: Did you see the cat run away?
items.6w4_d_1: No, I didn't see it run. But I heard it.
items.6w4_d_3: My brother does. He saw everything.
items.6w4_copy: Did you see who took the ball? I didn't see anyone near the door. Does your friend know the answer? He doesn't know, but he heard a noise.
items.6w5_d_0: Why did you stay home yesterday?
items.6w5_d_1: I stayed home because I was sick.
items.6w5_d_2: Do you want tea or juice now?
items.6w5_d_3: I like both, but I will choose juice today.
items.6w5_g_0: I was hungry, so I ate a sandwich.
items.6w5_g_1: I like dogs, but I am afraid of cats.
items.6w5_g_2: You can have juice or water.
items.6w5_g_3: I stayed home because it was raining.
items.6w5_copy: I finished my homework, so I could play outside. I wanted to play soccer, but it started to rain. I could watch TV or read a book. I chose to read because the story was exciting.
items.6w6_d_0: There is a problem with our playground.
items.6w6_d_2: There are not enough trash cans.
items.6w6_d_3: We can ask the school for more!
items.6w6_g_0: There is a problem in our classroom.
items.6w6_g_1: There are too many papers on the floor.
items.6w6_g_2: We can clean it up together.
items.6w6_copy: There is a small garden behind our school. There are not many flowers in it. We can plant more flowers together. I can't wait to see it grow.
items.6w7_d_0: What is your plan for next month?
items.6w7_d_1: We are going to visit my grandma.
items.6w7_d_2: That sounds fun! I will miss you.
items.6w7_d_3: Don't worry, I will send you photos.
items.6w7_g_1: We are going to visit Japan next month.
items.6w7_g_2: It will rain tomorrow, I think.
items.6w7_g_3: I am going to prepare my bag tonight.
items.6w7_copy: Next month, my family is going to travel. We are going to visit the mountains. I will pack my bag the night before. I hope the weather will be nice.
items.6w8_d_0: Tell us about your past and your future plan.
items.6w8_d_1: Last month, I visited my cousin. We had a great time.
items.6w8_d_3: Next month, I am going to visit him again. I will bring a gift.
items.6w8_g_0: Last week, I visited my cousin.
items.6w8_g_1: We had a great time together.
items.6w8_g_2: Next month, I am going to visit him again.
items.6w8_g_3: I will bring him a gift.
items.6w8_copy: Last summer, I went to the beach with my family. We swam and ate ice cream together. Next summer, I am going to go camping instead. I will bring my camera to take photos.
